newsitem.title: CUBA: Cuban recovers after nine days trapped in well.
newsitem.headline: Cuban recovers after nine days trapped in well.

text.p: A Cuban man was recovering after being trapped down an old well for nine days with a broken leg, state media said on Tuesday.

Argelio Cabrera, 25, who was rescued on Sunday, had fallen down the well nine days earlier while walking through the countryside in the eastern province of Las Tunas on his way to visit his father, the news agency AIN said.
He broke his leg in the fall and bandaged it with his clothes. He had only the muddy water at the bottom of the well to drink, it said.
Cabrera had tried to attract attention by shouting but was not discovered until a group of people going fishing at a local river passed near the well.
AIN said Cabrera, who was recovering in a hospital in the city of Las Tunas, was suffering a severe infection from his broken leg, but his condition was not life-threatening.
AIN did not say how deep the well was.
